figurative_meaning_en: Managing a man's daily life and family responsibilities
example_sentences_in_bangla: তিনি সকাল থেকে রাত পর্যন্ত কাজ করে সংসার চালান।
এই বয়সে সংসার চালানো খুব কঠিন হয়ে পড়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He works from morning till night to run the household.
Running the family has become very difficult at this age.
note: This idiom often implies traditional gender roles where men are primary providers in Bengali society.
